articles.title: Gemini sells UK and European operations to stablecoin payments firm KAST for under $10 million
articles.description: The sale follows the Winklevoss-founded crypto exchange’s retreat from several overseas markets as it restructures its business.

articles.title: Ukrainian defense tech startup hits $6 billion valuation as investors bet on battle-tested drones
articles.description: UFORCE's NEMESIS drones have completed 300,000 combat flights, and its MAGURA naval vessels have contributed to the destruction of Russian warships.

articles.title: BlackRock Bitcoin ETF outflows hit $2B over nine sessions
articles.description: US spot Bitcoin ETF outflows rose to nearly $300 million on Wednesday, up from $95 million a day earlier, as five-session withdrawals reached $1.44 billion.

articles.title: Canaan may sell more bitcoin for stock buybacks as mining-rig revenue falls 96%
articles.description: The Avalon maker has launched a $20 million repurchase program, while most of its bitcoin holdings were pledged or placed in a fixed-term product at September’s end.

articles.title: Treasury yields edge higher as investors await fresh inflation and housing data
articles.description: Treasury yields rose as bond markets reopened following Veterans Day.

articles.title: MSCI is dropping Strategy from its index, and the exclusion could hit its bitcoin-buying machine
articles.description: MSCI’s decision to exclude Strategy from its equity indexes could hamper the company’s ability to buy more bitcoin, according to some analysts.

articles.title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
articles.description: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, Web3 and crypto regulation.

articles.title: South Korea to permit crypto withdrawal freezes during hacking threats
articles.description: The move follows recent security incidents involving South Korean crypto exchanges, including GOPAX’s precautionary suspension of services and a $70,000 hot-wallet breach at Prabang.

articles.title: Zcash holders to vote on pulling 50,000 ZEC, worth $50 million, from grants treasury
articles.description: The proposal would remove more than half of Zcash Community Grants' ZEC holdings from circulation and redirect its future block rewards into a new development and legal-defense fund.

articles.title: Bitcoin Core reveals bug that made thousands of nodes trust any stranger on Tor
articles.description: The flaw was fixed in October 2025 and kept quiet until Tuesday. It came out alongside a high-severity bug that could stop a miner from producing blocks until someone restarted it.

articles.title: Ripple’s bank-lending system moves closer to launch on the XRP Ledger
articles.description: Lending support among the ledger’s 35 validators has climbed from 19 to 22 since mid-October, and no public tracker shows which validators switched.

articles.title: Binance CSO unwittingly foreshadowed $6.3B hack tactic months before attack
articles.description: In a July interview, Binance chief security officer Jimmy Su explained how fake coding assessments could compromise employee devices, a tactic later used in the exchange’s record-breaking hack.

articles.title: Nvidia perps crash 7% as CEO Jensen Huang reportedly faces the axe
articles.description: Nvidia perps are down 7% on Hyperliquid as traders react to reports that CEO Jensen Huang may be removed. Bitcoin continues to trade in a familiar price range.

articles.title: The world's super-rich are piling into alternative investments. Here's why
articles.description: Alternative investments now account for 60% of single-family office portfolios, surpassing traditional assets for the first time, according to BNY Wealth.

articles.title: Elon Musk says it would be an 'honor' to hire Nvidia's Jensen Huang
articles.description: The post on X comes amid reports that Nvidia's board is preparing to oust Huang.

articles.title: What we know so far about Nvidia partner Megaspeed’s Asia footprint

articles.title: CFTC investigates if Kalshi improperly self-certified event contracts
articles.description: News of the probe comes after the CFTC ordered Kalshi to take down a sports-related "mention markets" back in August.

articles.title: Cramer's stance on Nvidia's stock amid reports that CEO Jensen Huang may be ousted
articles.description: Jim Cramer said Wednesday night that he was saddened by a news report that indicated Nvidia's board of directors is preparing to fire Huang.
